messages:
Elena: Quick recap from design review 1: action column behavior on narrow widths + revoke/rotate copy + accessible undo. Two asks: keep copy button visible, fix tab order, and make undo keyboard-focusable.

Tom: On widths <=760px collapse meta (date/owner) but keep icons for copy/reveal and the kebab. Don't hide copy behind the menu.

Priya: Tabbing currently: checkbox -> name -> reveal -> kebab. Should be checkbox -> name -> kebab -> copy -> reveal. Make reveal reachable via menu if needed. Also increase icon hit area to 32px.

Sam: Revoke modal copy proposal: "Revoke API key" / "Revoking disables this key immediately. You will have 10 seconds to undo." Primary: Revoke key. Secondary: Cancel. Make warning text bolder to meet 4.5:1. Toast: "Key revoked 10s94 Undo" with focusable Undo.

aria-bot: Linter alert: possible contrast failure on small revoke helper text (A11Y:CONTRAST). Ensure aria-modal and role="alertdialog" on revoke modal; update aria-live region on toast: "Credential revoked. Undo available."

Elena: Thanks 11 I'll update Figma and open two tickets: (1) action-column collapse + tabindex/order + hit targets, (2) revoke/rotate copy + undo toast + a11y fixes. @Tom please estimate effort.
